hints: The failure occurs when the token manager attempts to call the VPC Instance Metadata Service to retrieve an IAM token.
The version string used in the request is defined as METADATA_SERVICE_VERSION in the VPCInstanceTokenManager class.
The test output shows the expected version (2022-03-01) differs from the actual version (2021-09-20) used in the request.
brief.lesson: The fix updates the METADATA_SERVICE_VERSION constant in the VPCInstanceTokenManager class from '2021-09-20' to '2022-03-01', aligning with the version expected by the VPC Instance Metadata Service. This resolves the version mismatch and allows the token manager to successfully request tokens.
